content.title: Engineering Manager
bullets: Led a team of 8 engineers delivering a payments platform rewrite on schedule.
Introduced sprint planning and quarterly roadmapping used across 3 teams.
Managed vendor relationships and budget for a $2M annual engineering spend.

job.title: Senior Program Manager
job.descriptionMd: We are hiring a Senior Program Manager to run large cross-functional initiatives. REQUIRED: active PMP (Project Management Professional) certification. Also required: 5+ years leading engineering or product teams, budget ownership, and stakeholder management experience.
